name: Nivel 2 - Reposicion pan con validacion humana

parameters.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.Fecha, '%Y-%m-%d') AS fecha, f.Pan_comprado AS pan_comprado, f.Stock_pan AS stock_pan, DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d') AS fecha_hoy FROM Flujo_Pan AS f WHERE f.Fecha BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND CURDATE() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Flujo_Pan WHERE Fecha = CURDATE()) ORDER BY f.Fecha ASC;
